active_in_year_definition: active in Y iff certification_year <= Y AND (retirement_year is empty OR retirement_year > Y); retirement = isochrones 7-source consensus
deduplication_rule: ABU_NET_NEW excludes NPIs already present in the ABOG cohort; ABOG_PLUS_ABU = ABOG + ABU_NET_NEW with no double count
known_limitations: BOOTSTRAP pending the versioned isochrones artifacts release.
ABU is a 2023 snapshot only (no by-year series); abu_net_new/combined are NA before 2023.
2013-2015 predate the ~2016 retirement-detection window and are approximate.
